title: Late Claims and Binder-Based Coverage for Stand-Alone Fittings Under the Vision Plans
content:
Under the Vision Plans, whether a stand-alone contact-lens fitting is settled under the fitting benefit is decided in this order:

- **First — the filing limit.** The claim may have reached Cascade more than the filing limit after the date of service: 180 calendar days at a participating location, 365 calendar days out of network. It is then denied for timely filing. The member owes nothing for it at a participating location, and keeps the whole receipt out of network.
- **Next — a binder on an applied enrollment.** Otherwise, the enrollment may still stand applied while the latest binder payment the funding billing account received meets three conditions: it was not returned, it is for at least the plan unit's monthly premium for its coverage tier, and it was received on or before the binder deadline. The latest binder payment is the account's latest payment with payment purpose binder in the Premium Billing Accounts records, and it is returned when a returned-payment entry names it. The binder deadline is the coverage effective date plus 30 calendar days, a payment on the deadline day being in time. A fitting dated on or after the coverage effective date is then settled under the fitting benefit, coverage having started retroactively on that date.
- **Otherwise — the enrollment's own record.** The fitting is settled under the fitting benefit only when the enrollment is active or terminated and the date of service is on or after its coverage effective date and on or before its termination date when it has one. Otherwise it is denied as not eligible and the member pays the whole billed charge.

| Figure | Inside | Outside |
|---|---|---|
| Participating filing limit | Received by day 180 | Day 181 or later |
| Out-of-network filing limit | Received by day 365 | Day 366 or later |
| Binder deadline | Received by day 30 after the coverage effective date | Day 31 or later |

*Hypothetical case.* A fitting at a participating independent practice on an enrollment effective 1 August that still stands applied. A full, unreturned binder arrived 31 August, so a fitting dated 15 August is settled under the fitting benefit. Had the binder been returned, the fitting would be denied as not eligible at the whole billed charge.
